structure_note: Paper II is a flat list of ten units with no lettered parts - unlike Paper I, which carries PART A Physical / PART B Human. section_ref is therefore omitted (rev2 M10). Note also that Q1 of this paper is a map-location question of about 10 items; those PYQ rows carry only the location names and are flagged requires_map_sheet.

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 1. Physical Setting: Space relationship of India with neighbouring countries; Structure and relief; Drainage system and watersheds; Physiographic regions; Mechanism of Indian monsoons and rainfall patterns, Tropical cyclones and western disturbances; Floods and droughts; Climatic regions; Natural vegetation; Soil types and their distributions.
micro_themes: Space relationship of India with neighbouring countries
Mechanism of the Indian monsoon and rainfall patterns

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 2. Resources: Land, surface and ground water, energy, minerals, biotic and marine resources; Forest and wild life resources and their conservation; Energy crisis.
micro_themes: Forest and wildlife resources and their conservation

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 3. Agriculture: Infrastructure - irrigation, seeds, fertilizers, power; Institutional factors - land holdings, land tenure and land reforms; Cropping pattern, agricultural productivity, agricultural intensity, crop combination, land capability; Agro and social-forestry; Green revolution and its socio-economic and ecological implications; Significance of dry farming; Livestock resources and white revolution; aquaculture; sericulture, apiculture and poultry; agricultural regionalisation; agro-climatic zones; agro-ecological regions.
micro_themes: Agricultural infrastructure: irrigation, seeds, fertilizers, power
Institutional factors: land holdings, land tenure and land reforms
Cropping pattern, agricultural productivity and intensity
Green Revolution and its socio-economic and ecological implications
Livestock resources and the White Revolution
Agricultural regionalisation; agro-climatic zones and agro-ecological regions

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 4. Industry: Evolution of industries; Locational factors of cotton, jute, textile, iron and steel, aluminium, fertilizer, paper, chemical and pharmaceutical, automobile, cottage and agro-based industries; Industrial houses and complexes including public sector undertakings; Industrial regionalisation; New industrial policies; Multinationals and liberalization; Special Economic Zones; Tourism including eco-tourism.
micro_themes: Locational factors of cotton, jute and textile industries
Iron and steel, aluminium and fertilizer industries
Paper, chemical, pharmaceutical and automobile industries
Industrial houses and complexes including public sector undertakings
Industrial regionalisation and new industrial policies
Multinationals and liberalization; Special Economic Zones

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 5. Transport, Communication and Trade: Road, railway, waterway, airway and pipeline networks and their complementary roles in regional development; Growing importance of ports on national and foreign trade; Trade balance; Trade Policy; Export processing zones; Developments in communication and information technology and their impacts on economy and society; Indian space programme.
micro_themes: Road, railway, waterway, airway and pipeline networks
Complementary roles of transport modes in regional development
Growing importance of ports in national and foreign trade
Developments in communication and information technology
Impacts of IT on economy and society

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 6. Cultural Setting: Historical Perspective of Indian Society; Racial, linguistic and ethnic diversities; religious minorities; major tribes, tribal areas and their problems; cultural regions; Growth, distribution and density of population; Demographic attributes - sex-ratio, age structure, literacy rate, work-force, dependency ratio, longevity; migration (inter-regional, intra-regional and international) and associated problems; Population problems and policies; Health indicators.
micro_themes: Racial, linguistic and ethnic diversities; religious minorities
Major tribes, tribal areas and their problems
Growth, distribution and density of population
Demographic attributes: sex ratio, age structure, literacy, work-force
Population problems and policies; health indicators

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 7. Settlements: Types, patterns and morphology of rural settlements; Urban developments; Morphology of Indian cities; Functional classification of Indian cities; Conurbations and metropolitan regions; urban sprawl; Slums and associated problems; town planning; Problems of urbanization and remedies.
micro_themes: Types, patterns and morphology of rural settlements
Conurbations and metropolitan regions; urban sprawl

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 8. Regional Development and Planning: Experience of regional planning in India; Five Year Plans; Integrated rural development programmes; Panchayati Raj and decentralised planning; Command area development; Watershed management; Planning for backward area, desert, drought prone, hill, tribal area development; multi-level planning; Regional planning and development of island territories.
micro_themes: Experience of regional planning in India; Five Year Plans
Command area development and watershed management
Planning for backward, desert and drought-prone areas
Regional planning and development of island territories

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 9. Political Aspects: Geographical basis of Indian federalism; State reorganisation; Emergence of new states; Regional consciousness and inter-state issues; International boundary of India and related issues; Cross border terrorism; India's role in world affairs; Geopolitics of South Asia and Indian Ocean realm.
micro_themes: State reorganisation and the emergence of new states
International boundary of India and related issues
Geopolitics of South Asia and the Indian Ocean realm

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 10. Contemporary Issues: Ecological issues - Environmental hazards: landslides, earthquakes, Tsunamis, floods and droughts, epidemics; Issues related to environmental pollution; Changes in patterns of land use; Principles of environmental impact assessment and environmental management; Population explosion and food security; Environmental degradation; Deforestation, desertification and soil erosion; Problems of agrarian and industrial unrest; Regional disparities in economic development; Concept of sustainable growth and development; Environmental awareness; Linkage of rivers; Globalisation and Indian economy.
micro_themes: Changes in patterns of land use
Environmental impact assessment and environmental management
Environmental degradation; deforestation, desertification and soil erosion
Problems of agrarian and industrial unrest
Concept of sustainable growth and development; environmental awareness
